_workflowPatterns._comment: Reference patterns for workflow authors. Not enforced programmatically.
_workflowPatterns.nullPrGuard: When a workflow uses the workflow_run trigger, always add a job-level guard to skip execution when the triggering event has no associated pull requests. Pattern (from pr-finalizer.yml): `if: github.event_name != 'workflow_run' || toJSON(github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests) != '[]'`. This prevents wasted runner time on orphaned workflow_run events.
